title: Bare Bones x Asa's Potions
description: Retextures Asa's Potions to emulate the style of Bare Bones and the trailers.
body:
![Bare Bones x Asa's Potions v1.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce40afb8716d07839e99b22822fee5242720cf29.png)

I've always loved the vanilla textures of Minecraft. However, I always thought it would be cool if certain repetitive items had unique textures, with potions being one of these items. So I set out to make a unique texture for every potion in the game while attempting to emulate the vanilla art style.

This is the official retexture of my pack for Bare Bones to emulate the style of the trailers.

## Identification
I attempted to make a predictable and understandable pattern for how the potion textures evolve depending on their ingredients. All potions now have a unique texture, with their variants displaying small changes depending on their length, power, or bottle type. Potions diluted with redstone are longer and appear in a larger bottle. On the other hand, glowstone makes the potion more potent and concentrated, allowing for a smaller bottle also distinguishable with a golden band.

![This image is titled “Potion Levels Example (Potion of Regeneration)”. Below the title is a potion progression tree showing all evolutions of the regeneration potion. Starting on the left with a water bottle and an awkward potion showing how the potion can be made. The image then shows a basic regeneration potion in a standard sized, heart shaped bottle. Above that bottle is a larger sized bottle of the same shape for longer potions, there is a smaller bottle bellow with a gold band around it used for more potent potions. The image then displays all three of these bottles with glass stoppers instead of normal corks representing splash potions. The image then displays three more potions all with the lingering potion stopper type.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fda998e86eb9a588265fcb8f8cb09d27890e467.png)

_In the image above, all variations and components of the regeneration potion progression tree can be seen as the primary example of how potion identification works in this pack._

### All The Potions
All potions follow these rules and have each been given a unique look as to try and make them easily distinguishable from one another.

![This image displays every unique potion texture for the 1.0 release of Bare Bones x Asa's Potions (Asa’s Bare Potions) by SimplyAsa.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa035a4904149e9f5b9321ee08d91fbe14033503.png)

_In the image above, All implemented potion textures for the 1.0 release of this pack are visible._

## The Future of Asa's Potions
More information on the future of Asa's Potions and Bare Bones x Asa's Potions (Asa's Bare Potions) will be available on the primary page for Asa's Potions.

## Currently Supported Potions
Minecraft : 1.21.5+
